about_the_game:
Get ready for a next-generation truck simulator.

Travel across Australia behind the wheel of a multi-ton truck, exploring miles of roads: from picturesque coastal highways to rugged dirt tracks. Enjoy every sunrise and sunset on this magnificent continent.

Discover the freedom beyond the truck cab!

Now you can step out of the truck to secure the hitch, check, and distribute the load yourself. Refuel the truck manually by inserting the nozzle into the tank. Experience true realism and freedom in every aspect of the game!

Cargo - more than just a trailer

Discover a variety of trailer types, each offering unique loading mechanics. Place cargo in the trailer, load the semi-trailer and fill the tanker yourself. Keep in mind that the placement and weight of the cargo affect truck handling. Plan your load carefully, considering the truck’s capabilities and road conditions. And don't forget, we are in Australia, the home of road trains with multiple trailers.

Australia

Immerse yourself in the unique nature and diversity of Australia. Explore miles of asphalt roads, dirt and gravel tracks with rugged terrain. The vast territory will give you the freedom to explore and find the best routes.

Dynamic weather conditions and day-night cycle

Experience the realistic impact of weather conditions on truck handling. Rain, snow, and fog turn every journey into a unique challenge that requires extra attention. Enjoy magnificent sunrises and sunsets behind the wheel of a heavy truck as day smoothly transitions into night, adding even more realism and atmosphere to your trip.



More features:
  • Transport cargo across Australia.
  • Interactive cabin - all main controls in the cab are now interactable.
  • Active participation in road events.
  • Tablet for managing orders and company without exiting the menu.
  • Advanced semi-trailer loading system with manual cargo distribution.
  • Online co-op for up to 4 players to complete orders.
  • Variety of trucks, from old models to modern 18-wheel monsters.
  • Unlock, upgrade, and customize your trucks.
  • Realistic traffic.
  • Various road events: accidents, roadworks, natural phenomena.
  • Interactions with the police and fine system.
  • Develop your character and obtain licenses for transporting different cargoes.
  • Gaming steering wheels support.

  • Processor: Intel i3-4130 3.4 GHz / AMD Ryzen 3 2200U 3.4 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 2 GB, GeForce GTX 660 / Radeon R9 270

  • Storage: 30 GB available space

short_description: Take a breathtaking journey across Australia behind the wheel of a multi-ton truck. Explore highways and dirt tracks, enjoy the beautiful nature. Step out of the cab to manually secure the hitch and inspect your cargo. Freedom and realism await you!
